required_semantics: 55F449 rejects only signed channel>2, before the disabled check; negative channel accesses use wrapped32-bit addressing. Returns1 even when open fails.
55F639 has no channel range guard. It checks disabled first, checks and reloads the handle, then calls stream volume.
55F449 caches selected volume before loop-count call, reloads stream handles for each backend call and publishes the new handle before checking it.
55F32F publishes volume first and reloads the stream after status. Full physical audio remains external.
next_validation: Compare explicit C receivers and native thiscall cleanup. Cover signed negative/wrapped channels, disabled ordering, open failure, close-before-open, cached volume and handle reloads across every backend callback. Execute full voice compositions with actual stream methods and only Miles backend endpoints controlled.
